items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

ctx.x: Yeah, I played down there. That's right. Played down there. And then. What year that was in? Oh, that's, that's around 1907, the eight. Back up in there. Yeah. Because Charlie McDonough, he was, he come there after Julietta. Yeah. Charlie McDonough, the colored fella. They all played there for Charlie McDonough. Yeah, I played for all of them. He was the manager then, the Dungle of the Spikes. That's right, Charlie McDonough.

You mentioned a few minutes ago about Vinson, the trombone, Eddie Vinson, the trombone player. I never did get to see him or hear him. He died so long ago, I guess up in Chicago. Yeah, he died. Can you tell us any more about him, what he was like and anything, do you know anything about his family or folks, where he came from?
